description_en: Queries the details of a specified device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定设备的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-device-detail --product-key a1Bw000000 --device-name Device01 --iot-id C47T6xwp6ms4bNlkHRWCg40000 --project-id a123qs00000sy4QU --api-version 2023-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceDetail

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the video device belongs.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备所属产品的ProductKey。

<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the video device.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备名称。

<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the video device.
<notice>
IotId is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备ID。
<notice>
IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see Error codes in this topic
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful

ActiveTime.description_en: The time when the device was activated. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds
ActiveTime.description_zh: 设备的激活时间，13位毫秒级时间戳

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the device was created. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 设备的创建时间，13位毫秒级时间戳

FirmwareVersion.description_en: The version number of the default OTA module of the device
FirmwareVersion.description_zh: 设备默认（default）OTA模块的版本号

IpAddress.description_en: The IP address of the device

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:

0: device. A device cannot mount child devices.
1: gateway. A gateway can mount child devices
NodeType.description_zh:
节点类型，取值：

0：设备。设备不能挂载子设备。
1：网关。网关可以挂载子设备

OnlineTime.description_en: The last online time of the device. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
OnlineTime.description_zh: 设备最后上线时间，13位毫秒级时间戳

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

ProductName.description_en: The name of the product to which the device belongs

Region.description_en: The ID of the region where the device resides

Status.description_en:
The device status. Valid values:

ONLINE: The device is online.
OFFLINE: The device is offline.
UNACTIVE: The device is not activated.
DISABLE: The device is disabled
Status.description_zh:
设备状态。取值：

ONLINE：设备在线。
OFFLINE：设备离线。
UNACTIVE：设备未激活。
DISABLE：设备已禁用

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
